headline: Why vector search misses connections (Graph Engineering)
narration: Standard vector search finds similar paragraphs, but it fails at multi-hop relationships across files, people, and systems.

headline: Entities + Typed Edges = Structural Memory
narration: Graph engineering extracts nodes and typed edges from your code or docs, letting agents traverse dependencies in one query.

headline: Pair Graph RAG with Vector Search
narration: Use vector search for fuzzy meaning, and use a knowledge graph for impact analysis, architecture questions, and multi-hop reasoning.
